{"number":1664,"title":"claudinite-dashboard: move the Pages deploy into a publish-pages task, leaving a four-step workflow","body":"Closes #1663

## What

The seeded `claudinite-dashboard-pages.yml` decided for itself when to republish the dashboard, built the site, and carried the build's inputs, all in `.github/workflows/`, the one directory the nightly update cannot converge. Now the task owns all of that and the workflow holds only what needs a workflow job.

- **`tasks/publish-pages/`** (new, `task.json` form): `daily`, agentless, preconditions `mount-moved || commits-under:.claudinite-settings.json || commits-under:.claudinite-checks.json`, `schedule_after: ['claudinite-lifecycle/update']`. The worker builds the site with `build-site.mjs` into a scratch directory (a refused declaration fails in the executor's log; a mount without the page ends as "nothing to publish"), writes a `deployed.json` stamp, force-pushes the tree as one root commit to `gh-pages` with the Action's own token, dispatches the workflow on the default branch, and follows the run to a terminal state. A failed deploy with Pages not enabled parks `needs-human-action` naming the setting; other failures park with the run URL.
- **The stub**: `workflow_dispatch` only, one job, four `uses:` steps: checkout of `gh-pages`, `configure-pages`, `upload-pages-artifact`, `deploy-pages`. No `run:` step, no Node, no variables, no path filter, no `workflow_run` catch-up, no cache. Pages source stays *GitHub Actions*.
- **`pack.mjs`**: header and handover step describe the split; `seedOps` unchanged. Version 60902.15, with its `VERSIONS.md` row.
- **`build-site.mjs`**: keeps `tasks/` out of the published tree.
- **Tests**: the three stub-shape tests in `pack.test.mjs` and the cache-key test in `deployment-config.test.mjs` now pin the new shape (uses-only, dispatch-only, no variables in the frozen file). New `test/tasks/publish-pages/worker.test.mjs` drives the worker against a bare repo and a scripted API: declaration validates, one commit per push, re-push never conflicts, no site means no run, Pages-disabled parks as action, unreadable setting is a failure, missing workflow parks as action.

## Why the workflow cannot go entirely

A deploy with source *GitHub Actions* is `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pages/deployments` with an `artifact_id` and an `oidc_token` (`actions/deploy-pages`, `src/internal/api-client.js`). The artifact is uploaded through `ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN`, which the runner hands to action steps and not to `run:` steps, and the OIDC token is minted per job. Code-work is a `run:` step's subprocess, so it can do neither.

## Verified

- `packs/claudinite-dashboard/**/*.test.mjs`: 412 pass. Tasks, lifecycle and engine suites: all pass once the clone is deep enough for the shim-history test.
- `check_the_world.mjs`: the one blocking finding is `pack-version-claimed-once` on `packs/claudinite-tasks/VERSIONS.md` (two rows claim 60903.3), already on `main` and untouched here.

## Members

A member's seeded workflow does not converge, so each one holding the old stub keeps working on the old shape until its `.github/workflows/claudinite-dashboard-pages.yml` is replaced by hand with the new stub. Shepherd's is in missingbulb/Shepherd#423.

# Merge to main

If the project's own `CLAUDE.md` names a merge-policy file, that file overrides the divergent
points below (merge method, CI gating). Don't go hunting for one it doesn't name.

1. Load `create_pull_request` + `merge_pull_request` in one `ToolSearch`.
2. No PR open for the branch? `create_pull_request` (base `main`), body ending `Closes #<issue>`.
3. If the PR has check runs, wait for them to pass. None — merge without waiting.
4. `merge_pull_request`, `merge_method: squash`, title `<subject> (#<pr>)`. Don't pre-read
   mergeability; the call fails loudly.
5. Sync local `main`: `git checkout main && git pull origin main`.
6. Capture the conversation:
   `node .claudinite/shared/packs/claudinite-growth/capture-log.mjs --issue <n>`
   (in the canon repo: `node packs/claudinite-growth/capture-log.mjs --issue <n>`). Skip only if
   the repo doesn't declare `claudinite-growth`. A later merge in the same session runs it
   again. (1)
7. Run the basics pack's
   [verify-in-production](../../../basics/skills/verify-in-production/SKILL.md) skill, unasked.
   This step is that skill's **only** trigger — it files against what the squash actually landed,
   which is why it runs here and not when the code was written or the PR opened. It decides
   whether this change needs a production check at all — most don't — and files the issue that
   comes back once the change is live. Never offer the owner to check later instead.

Don't re-read the issue to confirm it closed — `Closes #<issue>` does that on merge.
